label: vocr6-final-test
registered: this file's first commit on feat/vocr6-final-test (see git log), with the driver eval/reproducibility/vocr6-final/report.sh and eval/vocr6_final_test.py, before this harness read any protected set
what: VOCR6 stage 4's final test (eval/vocr6_protocol.json stages.4.final_test, branch feat/vocr6-t1-stages): read once, after every VOCR6 choice, on the blobs chosen to ship with VOCR5 beside them. Report only: no choice changes after it, and nothing here selects, tunes, drops or calibrates anything.

steps.1_register: this protocol and the driver are committed before any read
steps.2_validate: the driver's path (a) on VOCR5 only (report.sh - OUT with PATHS=a): it must reproduce VOCR5's locked numbers exactly (validation below). Path (b) is not read on any protected set in this step; VOCR6 is not read
steps.3_final_read: after vocr6-lead's message 'FINAL READ S=<blob> N=<blob> L=<blob>': stage the three blobs (vocr6_final_test.py stage), then report.sh MODELS_DIR OUT once: VOCR6 and VOCR5 on paths (a) and (b), every set. Its attempt record (OUT/attempt.json, created exclusively) refuses a second final read
steps.4_publish: OUT/report.json + OUT/report.md, copied to $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr6-final-test/; the compact report (counts, rates, intervals, hashes; no text of a protected line, no crop) committed as eval/vocr6_final_test_<YYYYMMDD of the read>.json with the markdown as docs/vocr6-final-test.md

path_a.what: v0.3.0's plain blobs, the ones VOCR5's locked report read (eval/vocr5_report_spec_20261016.json)
path_a.pcsg00807_note: the hooked test title's path (a) is eval/vocr6_baseline.py's, which read the released gated arms below (docs/vocr6-data.md), so its VOCR5 arms are those

gated.what: the released head-gated blobs that Rubi main runs since API 42 (Rubi #307: models[] pins these three); path (b) reads VOCR5 through them, and the hooked test title's path (a) too (eval/vocr6_baseline.py ARMS)

vertical.use: eval/vocr6_baseline.py's vertical reader for textspot3's vertical boxes on the test title (path a), for both families: VOCR6 has no vertical model

VOCR6.what: the three blobs vocr6-lead's message FINAL READ S=<blob> N=<blob> L=<blob> names: the blobs chosen to ship (with their head gate / two-level head where stage 4's gate step adopted them)
VOCR6.staging: vocr6_final_test.py stage copies them to MODELS_DIR as S.vocr, N.vocr and L.vocr and records each source path, sha256, bytes and whether it holds a head gate and a two-level head (models.json), before any read
VOCR6.path_a: each blob as given, read by path (a)'s tools exactly as VOCR5's blobs are (their head gate and two-level head off where the tool has them off: vocr3_report, vocr_cli, clannad_refs; on where eval/vocr6_baseline.py turns them on for VOCR5: the blob's own gate on, its two-level head on N and L when present)
VOCR6.path_b: each blob as Rubi runs a pinned blob: the head gate on if the blob holds one, the two-level head on if it holds one (Rubi's ocr_head_gate = on, the default)

vita-test.screenshots: $HERD/shared/artifacts/eval (eval/fetch.py's layout); every screenshot is checked against the manifest's sha256 by path (b)'s plan
vita-test.fixed_lines: 206 hand-checked lines of 16 VNs (2 uncertain lines are never scored): dialogue = lines without the 'name' style
vita-test.whole_dialogue: the manifest's dialogue regions; a region holding an uncertain line is left out whole (2 regions, 4 lines); 82 regions

sets.pooled_vita_psp: vita-test and psp-test pooled (VOCR5's headline: 336 dialogue lines, 4,693 reference characters on the fixed lines; 175 regions, 4,635 dialogue characters of whole dialogue); Vita and PSP are always reported apart as well

clannad.lines: the frozen Claude references: 3,048 scored line crops (the long run's GRAD line crops, stored processed PNGs, read with invert off) of 2,177 pages; dialogue = the references' own not-name flag (2,052 lines, 33,485 characters), names 996 lines (2,209 characters)
clannad.pages: path (b) only: a page whose every long-run line is a reference ('ref') or was excluded as holding no text ('r1,r2 skip:notext', an empty reference) has a complete reference; its ROI (the session's lock, [32, 360, 896, 184] of the 960x544 frame, the frame checked against the capture journal's sha256) is the unit. A page with any other excluded line (cut, multi, unsure, ui, no agreement) is left out whole. The reference is the page's long-run lines top to bottom: text outside every long-run GRAD box is in no reference (a limit, below)

a.name: VOCR5's locked path, as published
a.vita_psp_fixed_lines: eval/vocr3_report.py shared (spec: the arms below, finder grad; pairs VOCR6_T:VOCR5_T): every hand-checked line crop (box + pad, eval/sets.py) through the scalar C W8I runtime built by vocr3_report from runtime/vocr.c, greedy, console polarity (primary; synth/common.line_dark's polarity contract) and native polarity; then eval/vocr5_dialogue.py tables (dialogue = lines without the 'name' style; names; all text; per style), as eval/reproducibility/stride16-20261023/report.sh did
a.vita_psp_fixed_lines_lm: the same crops, console polarity, through runtime/build/vocr_cli with beam 8 and the overlay's 1 MB LM of v0.2.6-ctclm.2 at its 1MB settings: --topk 8 --beam 8 --alpha 500 --beta 3500 --gate 8000 --lm-flags 2 --bracket 8000 (eval/run.py --model cmd:...), as VOCR5's and stride16's lm steps
a.vita_psp_whole_dialogue: vocr3_report shared's whole-dialogue part: every region at base, +4 and +8 native px, the C GRAD finder (mode 0), each crop read greedy with its dark flag, joined in finder order and scored by train/general_vn_textbox_guard.transcript_score: 'body' (no name-styled line) is the dialogue text, 'all' includes names
a.clannad: eval/clannad_refs.py arms --extra NAME=FILE#SHA256 (greedy W8I, invert off, on every stored line crop; a library built now by vocr3_report.build_native) with its own suffix and --into this harness's private directory, then score --suffix --pair VOCR6_T:VOCR5_T (and :Lens); dialogue pairs re-aggregated from the attempt's private per-line errors by eval/stride16_clannad_dialogue.py
a.pcsg00807: eval/vocr6_baseline.py build / read / score on the test split (docs/vocr6-data.md's baseline): clean crops; the C GRAD finder with and without the refinement (VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT) on every whole-dialogue region, console view; the textspot3 pick on every frame. Each crop: W8I with the blob's head gate on (and its two-level head on N and L when present), top-8, the counter re-decode {6000, 4000}, beam 8 + ctclm.2's 1 MB LM at Rubi's settings of 2026-10-26 (alpha 500, beta 3500, gate 8000, EOS, bracket 8000), the ungated re-read; decodes greedy, rubi and rubi_cascade (a line under 700 read by the next tier up of the same family). Run through vocr6_final_test.py pcsg-a, which sets vocr6_baseline.ARMS to the family's blobs (VOCR5: the released gated arms, its own ARMS; VOCR6: the three staged blobs; VOCR5-V for vertical boxes in both) and nothing else
a.arms: VOCR5_S/N/L (path_a blobs) and VOCR6_S/N/L (the staged blobs); for pcsg00807 the gated VOCR5 arms

b.name: Rubi's shipped path at the final read
b.resolution: vocr6_final_test.py rubi-path reads a checkout of bee-san/Rubi_for_vita main taken at the final read (its head recorded) and writes OUT/rubi_path.json before any read: the default LM tier Rubi main pins (core/vocr_ocr.c lms[] for VJO_VOCR_LM2_NAME, config.c's ocr_lm = 1000k; recorded beside the pinned LM since amendment 2, which fixes the LM read: paths.b.lm), the cascade threshold, the counter re-decode constants, the head-gate default, the refinement default, the finder fix default and textnorm's sha256. A Rubi value that is not one of the candidates below stops the read (no silent fallback)
b.finder: Rubi's line path on a grey region, eval/pagepath_find.c (a port of Rubi core/vocr_ocr.c's: VOCR_LINES_TEXTBOX_RECOVERY, the short-line probe #194, the per-box refinement with Rubi's 16-line cap) built with -DPAGEPATH_FIX: fix = the finder default Rubi ships, VOCR_FIX_DEFAULT = VOCR_FIX_COLGAP (1, #129 amendment 3; JUNK and VALLEY opt-in). If Rubi main does not pin runtime/vocr_lines_fix.c yet, COLGAP from vita-vn-ocr's runtime/vocr_lines_fix.c (main if #135 merged, else #135's head) all the same, as stage 4 amendment 1 cut stage 4a's plans; if Rubi pins it, that file (sha256 equal to Rubi's cmake/VocrOCR.cmake pin) and Rubi's default. probe 1; refinement VOCR_REFINE_ALL on PSP titles only (ocr_refine_lines = psp); the source files' sha256 recorded
b.view: the console view (what Rubi reads on a Vita): Vita frames as they are; a PSP frame upscaled 2x bilinear (cv2.INTER_LINEAR on the colour frame, then synth/common.to_gray), the regions and line boxes scaled by 2, the +4 / +8 px region variants by 8 / 16 px (eval/pagepath.py's console view)
b.line_read: each crop, as core/vocr_ocr.c finish_line reads it: W8I (runtime/vocr.c through runtime/pyvocr.py), the blob's head gate and two-level head on when it holds them, top-8 extras; a line read as empty stays empty (confidence 1000); the counter re-decode (6000 / 4000); the ungated re-read when the run skipped frames and the re-decode found a counter context, or the two-level head is on and the greedy text holds a full-size カ/ケ before 月所年国条 (read_again); the beam + LM decode over the (re-read, re-decoded) extras with the resolved LM settings; the line's confidence (conf_min x 1000 + 0.5 in float, truncated) from the read used
b.cascade: S -> N -> L within a family: a line whose confidence is under the resolved threshold (700) shows the next tier's reading of the same crop (the same line_read; empty when that tier's greedy text is empty); Large has none. The cascade's time ceiling (ocr_cascade_ms = 2000) is not modelled: every doubtful line is read again
b.display: Rubi's core/textnorm.c (built from the checkout; the counter rule, ー/一, widths, dashes, ellipses, the border-line rule), line by line, then the Shell's non_japanese_filter = lines (a line with no hiragana, katakana or CJK in [U+3040-U+30FF, U+4E00-U+9FAF] goes)
b.models: VOCR5: the gated blobs (models.VOCR5.gated, what Rubi main runs); VOCR6: the staged blobs

measures.vita_psp_whole_dialogue: path (a)'s regions and variants through the finder above, scored like path (a) (transcript_score: body = dialogue, all = with names)
measures.clannad_lines: path (a)'s 3,048 line crops (stored PNGs, invert off) through line_read, the cascade and the display: the units of VOCR5's CLANNAD numbers, with Rubi's decode
measures.clannad_pages: each page with a complete reference (sets.clannad.pages): its ROI through the finder (Vita: no refinement), every crop with its dark flag, joined in box order, transcript_score against the page's reference lines (body = not-name lines)
measures.pcsg00807_clean: the test pool's 1,152 clean line crops (invert off) through line_read, the cascade and the display

metrics.primary: dialogue CER: eval/metrics.norm on both sides, Levenshtein distance over reference characters, summed (errors / characters); speaker names a secondary column (fixed lines with the 'name' style; CLANNAD's name references; whole dialogue's 'all' minus 'body')
metrics.secondary: exact lines (fixed lines and CLANNAD lines); names CER; all-text CER; whole dialogue at +4 / +8 px; line statistics of the page path (whole / cut / missed lines, merged / junk boxes)
metrics.rounding: tables print 2 decimals from the integer counts; JSON keeps the counts

intervals.method: percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 0, numpy default_rng(seed).integers(0, n, (reps, n)) over sorted cluster ids, linear 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles (eval/vocr3_report.py paired_bootstrap / cluster_bootstrap)
intervals.rates: vita-test, psp-test and pooled: VN clusters (game bootstrap; at least 5 VNs); CLANNAD and the test title (one title each): page clusters; per title: screenshot clusters (vita-test, psp-test) or page clusters
intervals.pairs: VOCR6_T - VOCR5_T at each tier T, paired over the same units, the same clusters (game bootstrap for vita-test / psp-test / pooled, page bootstrap for CLANNAD and the test title); path (a)'s tools' own line / region intervals are kept beside them
intervals.reading: an interval that excludes 0 is called resolved; nothing is decided on it

reported.headline: per tier S / N / L: VOCR6 and VOCR5 dialogue CER with intervals and VOCR6 - VOCR5 with its paired interval, on CLANNAD (lines), vita-test + psp-test (fixed lines, pooled; whole dialogue at base) and the test title (clean lines; page path at base), path (b) first, then path (a)
reported.per_set: every set and measure above, per path, tier and family: dialogue CER [interval], names, exact lines; Vita and PSP apart where a measure has both; the pairs
reported.per_title: vita-test and psp-test: each VN's dialogue CER per tier and family on both paths (fixed lines; whole dialogue at base), with its seen flags
reported.decomposition: path (b): greedy -> rubi_tier -> rubi_cascade -> shipped on every measure; the test title's page path against its oracle boxes; CLANNAD's pages against its lines
reported.resources: each blob's bytes, sha256, W8I arena (C runtime), head gate / two-level head present
reported.outputs: OUT/report.json (public: counts, rates, intervals, hashes, ids of VNs and titles, no text) and OUT/report.md; per-unit rows and every reading under the private directory

code.harness: eval/vocr6_final_test.py (stage, rubi-path, pcsg-a, plan, read, score-b, validate, report, selftest, dryrun); tests/test_vocr6_final_test.py for its pure parts

code.selftest: vocr6_final_test.py selftest, on development data only (the hooked hval block): path (b)'s finder build against vocr6-lead's hval plan v2 (pagepath_find, fix 5, probe 1: every unit's boxes and dark flags), its line read with VOCR5's plain blobs against vocr6-lead's hval dumps of plan v1 (eval/vocr6_score.py read: greedy, beam text, confidence; the cascade, textnorm and filter against vocr6_score.texts), and with the gated arms against eval/vocr6_baseline.py's hval reads (greedy, the re-read's beam text, confidence). No protected set
code.dryrun: vocr6_final_test.py dryrun, on development data only: path (b)'s plan / read / score-b on stand-ins of the four sets built from the hooked hval block (vita-test- and psp-test-shaped manifests of four train titles' base regions, a clannad_refs-shaped work directory of one train title, the test-title path on a train title's hval split), then report on those rows with path (a)'s inputs copied from the validation's private outputs (VOCR6 entries copies of VOCR5's): the final read's code paths end to end, no protected set read by a model

limits: Host only: nothing ran on a console. Path (b) is a host model of Rubi's line path (eval/pagepath_find.c's port and core/vocr_ocr.c's finish_line as vocr6_final_test.py reproduces them); the cascade's time ceiling is not modelled

CLANNAD's references are the long run's GRAD line crops: the page measure's reference holds only text inside some long-run box, so a line every long-run box missed is no reference, and a finder that finds it is charged for it; pages with a cut, multi-line, UI or undecided crop are left out
The PSP console view is a cv2 bilinear 2x upscale, not an Adrenaline capture
The test title is one Vita game; its intervals are page bootstraps within it
Rubi's memory fallbacks are not modelled: a game without the memory for the LM or the cascade runs without them (game_ocr/main.c check_with_lm); path (b) is the job with both
Trusted hooks answering without OCR (Rubi API 43, hook_trust) are not modelled: path (b) is Rubi's OCR
CLANNAD's 133 pages without a reference line (and its 207 pages with an incomplete reference) are left out of the page measure, so a reading on an empty box is never charged there
hygiene: Nothing is chosen, tuned or dropped on vita-test, psp-test, CLANNAD or the test title; the final read reports
The protected sets are read only in step 2 (VOCR5, path (a), to reproduce published numbers) and step 3 (the one final read)
Harness fixes found by step 2 are committed (and named in the PR) before step 3; none may depend on a protected-set number other than the published VOCR5 numbers being reproduced
No text of a protected line, crop or screenshot is committed or sent anywhere; public files hold counts, rates, intervals, ids and hashes
No tool output with an all-caps *_DONE or *_BLOCKED token reaches the agent pane: every step logs to files

amendments.time: this commit (see git log); before this harness read any protected set (no validation and no final read had run)
amendments.why: robustness of the one final read, found by reviewing the driver before its first run
changes: report.sh resolves path (b)'s settings from Rubi main first in the final read (rubi-path before any read), so a Rubi value outside the protocol's candidates stops the read before anything is read

RESUME=1 continues an attempt a harness failure stopped: the attempt record stays, resumes.jsonl records each resume (time, repo head), and no step whose output exists runs again; every step's output is a file

path (b): a finder error on a region (rc != 0) is Rubi's job failing on it: no line, no text, counted (finder_errors); a crop the runtime refuses is recorded as an error and its unit shows nothing (read_errors), as Rubi's job fails (core/vocr_ocr.c run_error); neither raises

validate: the test title's finder build identity (finder_tighten.build's driver and library sha256, compiled from this checkout's runtime/, which #130 changed after the baseline ran) is recorded beside the checks, not compared as a score
